Overview & City Profile

Mogán (Mogán (Provincia de Las Palmas)) is a municipality in Provincia de Las Palmas, Canary Islands (coordinates 27.8354°N, -15.7159°E; population 24,225). Visitors use Mogán as a base to explore Canary Islands's historic town centers, regional markets, and culinary specialties such as Papas arrugadas con mojo picón y verde, Gofio escaldado, Queso Majorero & Almogrote.

Within Canary Islands Region (Provincia de Las Palmas region), Mogán (Mogán (Provincia de Las Palmas)) serves as a municipio (municipality) in canary islands region. Travelers exploring Canary Islands often combine a stop in Mogán with regional highlights such as Mount Teide National Park (Tenerife), Timanfaya Volcanic National Park (Lanzarote), Maspalomas Dunes & Roque Nublo (Gran Canaria), La Gomera Garajonay laurel forest.

Getting to Mogán & Getting Around

Via the regional hub (Santa Cruz de Tenerife / Las Palmas Central Station (Renfe AVE, Iryo & Ouigo High-Speed Rail)): Direct flights to Tenerife (TFS/TFN), Gran Canaria (LPA), Lanzarote (ACE) and Fuerteventura (FUE); Fred. Olsen & Armas inter-island ferries.

  • Local rail & IC cards: Once in Canary Islands Region, JR regional lines and local private railways connect Santa Cruz de Tenerife / Las Palmas with Mogán. Nationwide IC cards (Transit Card, Pasmo, Icoca) work on major urban and JR commuter gates; for rural branch lines or local buses, keep €1,000 bills and €100 coins handy for the onboard fare box.
  • Luggage & station lockers: Main stations in Canary Islands have coin lockers for day-trippers. If you are stopping in Mogán en route between larger bases, check your suitcase dimensions in our Luggage & Locker Checker or forward big bags ahead with Takkyubin.
  • Driving & car rental: While city centers around Mogán are accessible by train and taxi, renting a car from a major Renfe AVE, Iryo & Ouigo High-Speed Rail station or airport in Canary Islands can be rewarding for reaching mountain gorges, coastal viewpoints, and countryside onsen. Read our Renting a Car in Spain Guide.

Best Time to Visit & Seasonal Highlights

Best time to visit Canary Islands: Year-round (eternal spring 20–26°C).

Regional highlights across Canary Islands Region that pair well with a visit to Mogán include: Mount Teide National Park (Tenerife), Timanfaya Volcanic National Park (Lanzarote), Maspalomas Dunes & Roque Nublo (Gran Canaria), La Gomera Garajonay laurel forest.

Practical Travel Tips for Mogán

  • Tourist information center (観光案内所): Look for the Kankō Annaijo counter inside or right outside the main train station in Mogán (or at Santa Cruz de Tenerife / Las Palmas Central Station (Renfe AVE, Iryo & Ouigo High-Speed Rail)) for free walking maps, bus timetables, and festival calendars.
  • Cash & ATMs: While hotels, chain stores, and convenience stores in Mogán accept international cards and IC payment, smaller family-run restaurants, shrines, and rural buses often prefer cash. 7-Eleven (Seven Bank) and Spain Post ATMs accept foreign debit cards reliably.
  • Dining hours: Outside major metropolitan hubs, lunch typically runs 11:30 AM–2:00 PM and dinner spots open around 5:30 PM, with earlier last orders (around 8:00–9:00 PM) in smaller cities.

Frequently asked questions

Where is Mogán (Mogán (Provincia de Las Palmas)) located in Spain?

Mogán (Mogán (Provincia de Las Palmas)) is a municipio (municipality) located in Canary Islands Region in the Provincia de Las Palmas region of Spain (coordinates: 27.8354°N, -15.7159°E). It has a population of approximately 24,225 across an area of Regional km².

How do I get to Mogán by train?

Most visitors reach Mogán via the main prefectural gateway of Santa Cruz de Tenerife / Las Palmas Central Station (Renfe AVE, Iryo & Ouigo High-Speed Rail). Direct flights to Tenerife (TFS/TFN), Gran Canaria (LPA), Lanzarote (ACE) and Fuerteventura (FUE); Fred. Olsen & Armas inter-island ferries. From the regional hub, connect by JR local/rapid lines, private commuter railways, or local bus to Mogán. You can estimate long-distance rail costs using our Renfe AVE, Iryo & Ouigo High-Speed Rail Fare Calculator.

What local food is Mogán and Canary Islands known for?

In Mogán and across Canary Islands Region, top local dishes include Papas arrugadas con mojo picón y verde, Gofio escaldado, Queso Majorero & Almogrote, as well as Sancocho Canario and Malvasía volcanic wines of Lanzarote. Look for local ekiben (station bento boxes), morning markets, and family-run shokudo near the main station.

When is the best time of year to visit Mogán?

Best time to visit Canary Islands: Year-round (eternal spring 20–26°C). Check our Spain Seasonal Calendar to compare month-by-month weather and crowd levels.
